title: Report: Steelers dismiss senior assistant ST coach Derius Swinton for violating team policy

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Steelers dismiss senior assistant ST coach Derius Swinton for violating team policy
sources.description: The Steelers hired Derius Swinton as a senior assistant special teams coach this offseason, but he won't be with the team for the 2026 season.
